pcs.pc_description: check that the base on which the tower crane is mounted is clear of cracks
check the tightness of the bolts and nuts
visually examine all mast parts for defects and rust
examine the components of the operator station, such as the seat, instrument panel, crane load chart and communication equipment
check the panel board system for adequate power supply and switch functionality
check the levels of grease in components such as pulley, rope, trolley and swing gear parts
inspect load bearing structure components such as boom pins, pendant lines, boom hoist reeve or bridle, mast, base and under carriage for any wear and tear
examine the hoisting system for smooth movement of components such as wire rope, fittings, drums, hooks, sheaves and winch mounts
check for stabilizing system components for levels of counter & ballasted weights
inspect hydraulic system components like hydraulic fluid, filters, lines, pumps and fittings
check the engine oil levels and radiator coolant temperature indicators
ensure that the work site is clear from all personnel and other equipment before starting
keep a pre-operational check logbook to document all actions before operating the tower crane
if a fault is found that goes outside the scope of the role, notify the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: visually scan the place for any sources of blockage or persons inside the circumference/check for nearby high-rise natural or man-made structures/high voltage lines/wind pattern
test the working condition of the communication device along with the signalman
start the engine and examine the controls on the operational panel for proper operation
before raising the weight, ensure that the levers, hoist and trolley gears are in good working order
direct the trolley to position itself over the cargo in accordance with the signalman's instructions
control the boom's direction by moving the levers in accordance with the signalman's instructions
lower the rope with sufficient speed towards the weight in accordance with the signalman's instructions
conduct hoisting activities such as lifting and lowering the boom with the cargo from low to high altitudes
while raising and slewing the load, keep an eye on the load movement indications and anti- collision sensors
control the speed of the boom while moving left or right side with using lever/joystick
dump the material at the specified location in accordance with the signalman's instructions
return the trolley to its home location
before shutting down the operation, set the weather vane in the desired position
switch off the power supply in accordance with the operating instructions
climb down the tower crane while wearing safety equipment and following the proper procedures
do a walk-around visual examination to assess the overall condition of the equipment
keep a logbook to keep track of all actions
if a fault is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: Comply with safety, health, security and environment related regulations/guidelines at the work site
use personal protective equipment (ppe) and other safety gear as applicable to the equipment and the worksite
Follow safety measures during operations to ensure that the health and safety of self or others (including members of the public) is not at risk
Carry out operations as per the manufacturer's and worksite related health and safety guidelines
Handle the transport, storage and disposal of hazardous materials and waste in compliance with worksite health, safety and environmental guidelines
operate various grades of fire extinguishers, as applicable
support in administering basic first aid and report to concerned team members, as required, in case of an accident
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or emergency, within limits of your role and responsibility
record and report details related to operations, incidents or accidents, as applicable
